name: router-workers
description: Runs worker agents (headless Claude Code) on any model of a local Anthropic-compatible gateway such as 9router, and shows them live: a band above the prompt and a /router-workers panel with each worker's model, status, current action, tokens and time.

defaultModel.title: Default worker model
defaultModel.description: Gateway model id used when a delegate call names none (see the models tool)

gatewayUrl.title: Gateway URL
gatewayUrl.description: Base URL of the Anthropic-compatible gateway; empty uses ROUTER_GATEWAY_URL, then http://localhost:20128

gatewayKey.title: Gateway API key
gatewayKey.description: API key for the gateway; empty uses ROUTER_GATEWAY_KEY or gatewayConfigFile

gatewayConfigFile.title: Gateway config file
gatewayConfigFile.description: Optional JSON file with inferenceGatewayBaseUrl and inferenceGatewayApiKey (the shape of Claude desktop's third-party gateway config); ~ is your home

claudePath.title: Claude executable
claudePath.description: Path of the claude binary workers run; empty tries ~/.local/bin/claude(.exe), then claude on PATH
